min_standing_note.value: Must be officially nominated under an active bilateral agreement; exact prior-credit cutoff on third-party sites excluded unless confirmed on uib.no.

excluded_majors.notes: Open/restricted course status depends on academic background/faculty approval on uib.no/en/find-course; no major exclusion list verified.

min_gpa_host.notes: No fixed numeric GPA minimum verified directly on uib.no.

instruction_languages.notes: Bachelor (100-level) to Master (300-level) English-taught exchange courses available alongside Norwegian courses.

english_course_availability.notes: Dedicated exchange course finder filtered by language of instruction, faculty, and level (100-300).

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Minimum CEFR B2 level English required for English-taught courses (higher requirements such as C1 apply to specific subjects like English Literature).

fall_term_dates.value: Exact Autumn calendar dates hosted at https://www.uib.no/en/education/admission-and-application/semester-dates (date snippets in earlier query traced to third-party partner sites and excluded).

spring_term_dates.value: Exact Spring calendar dates hosted at https://www.uib.no/en/education/admission-and-application/semester-dates (date snippets in earlier query traced to third-party partner sites and excluded).

tuition_model.notes: Note: Tuition-exemption wording in search summaries did not resolve to a direct [uib.no] inline tag (though non-EU degree tuition on uib.no/91569 contrasts with semester-fee exemption on uib.no/104907); kept unknown pending direct official page text.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: UiB official pages cite UDI statutory immigration subsistence thresholds (NOK 77,440 Autumn / NOK 92,928 Spring / NOK 170,368 AY = NOK 15,488/mo in visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof) rather than a separate monthly student living budget; third-party Bergen estimates excluded.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: No UiB-published non-visa monthly living cost budget; UDI visa solvency threshold documented in visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Incoming exchange students are officially EXEMPT from paying UiB's semester fee (NOK 700, incl. NOK 50 optional SAIH) to Sammen while retaining full Sammen student welfare access.

housing_availability.notes: Incoming exchange students staying >=1 semester receive a housing guarantee through Sammen (Student Welfare Organisation in Western Norway) if applying and accepting strictly by Sammen deadlines (typically May 1 Autumn / Nov 1 Spring, or May 15/Nov 1 per Sammen).

housing_notes.value: Subsidized student housing via Sammen (https://www.sammen.no/en); rent normally includes internet, water, and heating; applicants must accept assigned room offer online by deadline even while admission is processing.

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: No incoming bilateral exchange stipend published on uib.no.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU/EEA students requiring a Norwegian Study Permit (UDI) must prove subsistence funds: NOK 77,440 (Autumn single semester), NOK 92,928 (Spring single semester), or NOK 170,368 (full Academic Year).

english_course_list_url.notes: Dynamic course finder at https://www.uib.no/en/find-course; filter by language of instruction = English, faculty, and level (100-300).

credit_system_and_load.notes: Norwegian ECTS framework used; exact exchange semester min/max ECTS limits only cited on third-party partner sheets in search_web.

course_restrictions_note.value: Courses on uib.no/en/find-course are marked open or restricted; restricted courses require academic background evaluation/faculty approval; 100-level BA to 300-level MA.

academic_style.notes: Not explicitly described in verified uib.no outputs.

city_tier.notes: Located in Bergen, Norway; population tier not cited directly on verified uib.no pages.

campus_type.notes: City-center Bergen campus description in search summary cited unverified third-party domains; kept unknown.

daily_life_english_friendliness.notes: Not rated on verified uib.no pages.

international_support_services.value: Sammen welfare services (health, counseling, cafeterias, sports, guaranteed subsidized student housing) accessed free of semester fee by exchange students.

nomination_deadlines.value: Student application deadline via Søknadsweb: Apr 25 (Autumn/AY) and Oct 15 (occasionally extended to Oct 18, Spring); preceded by partner university nomination (exact uib.no nomination cutoffs omitted as third-party-cited).
